text.tspan: My town used to be the capital
of our country. When settlers first
arrived in my town, the area was
very popular. There were several
roads from different trade centers
that went through my town. People
used to come to this town for
trade, business, and work. So 200
years ago, the government chose
my town for the capital. Everyone became used to visiting this town for
government, business, and trade.
Then times began to change and the world started becoming more
electronic and automated. While the town where I now live used to be one
of the few places nearby that people could travel to easily, many other
towns were started that people could reach easily enough by car or train.
Soon cities grew nearby in areas that used to be too hard to get to but
were now reachable by car. These cities soon grew larger than my town,
and the government decided to change the location of the capital for a
larger city.
Although my town used to be rather large, it is now smaller than it
used to be! I like it better this way, but I realize that the less government
and business that is done in a city, the fewer jobs there are. I don’t want
anyone to be out of a job, but at the same time, I like my town just the
way it is! In the future, I hope we can stay the same size but still provide
enough jobs for everyone. Perhaps if people began growing some of their
own food and living more simply, we could save more and still be able to
stay a small town.
My Town
